system_thesis_interpretation: V4 preserves the three cognitive functions and places schooling, controls, transactions, evaluation, and release outside them. THINK is the live child path that produces child-authored thought, a dispatched action, and a public developmental outcome. DREAM reconstructs finite waking context from committed lineage state; its cache is disposable and never an evidence source. Personal SLEEP is an ordinary response-only LoRA write over provenance-supported child-grounded life evidence. Bootstrap schooling is separate pre-life post-training: teachability and direct-solution adapters are each merged once into the same M0 to form immutable births, after which every personal adapter begins at zero effective delta on its assigned birth. Parenting and repetition affect waking opportunities only. Longitudinal parent prose and repetition-control metadata have no semantic edge into SLEEP; independently grounded child enactments can enter through the ordinary evidence path. Scientific evaluation is reporting-only, whereas private candidate preservation may affect only staged weight promotion. A rejected write preserves life and prior weights, and no current evidence or authority implements or validates this proposal.
graph_delta_interpretation: The bootstrap weight ancestry is M0 -> BT or BD through the sole response-only writer -> one FP32 reference merge and one BF16 rounding -> immutable M_birth_T or M_birth_D. BT/BD remain provenance artifacts but never personal runtime adapters. T and D originate from one permanent canonical transition pair: action, public outcome, admission, supervised-token count/position, action location, batch/update slot, and exogenous optimizer opportunity match; token identities differ only in declared treatment spans. T contains one frozen feedback computation, while D directly receives the rational action; computation 3 additionally requires an explicit no-new-evidence or negative-expected-value judgment, and computation 6 requires adapting a correction from a distinct earlier episode. The personal data spine separately types immutable evidence occurrences, supported lessons, rendered views, supervised exposures, updates, candidate closure, preservation evidence, verdict, and committed head. The authoritative head binds active weights, committed wake data, restricted parent audit, and control-plane repetition roots; DREAM is a derived cache. SLEEP may semantically read only eligible child-grounded wake evidence, the immutable birth, the previous child, and frozen compiler/writer inputs, while using the committed-head token only transactionally. A candidate closure is staged, privately evaluated, and supplied opaquely with its verdict to the promotion gate; CAS can replace only active weights. Parent/audit and repetition roots may be bound opaquely for transaction integrity but cannot alter selection, rendering, cache, dose, labels, or gradients. Scientific products have no edge to promotion or release; release consumes only a separately authorized audit/release decision and bound nonsemantic artifact roots.
loop_delta_interpretation: The ordered system begins with exact authority and model-free safety prerequisites. Bootstrap construction then freezes allowlisted sources, canonical pairs, process-advice templates, M0, writer, and toolchain; audits full attended rows and dose; trains BT/BD; reference-merges and content-addresses both births before downstream instances. Waking commits eligible child life evidence and independently commits parent/repetition control state. DREAM rebuilds waking context whenever authoritative roots change. A SLEEP attempt snapshots the opaque committed head, resolves support only from eligible life evidence, renders and encodes exact views, trains a fresh candidate from the immutable birth, and stages the complete closure. Private preservation evaluation compares candidate and previous child on the frozen panel, emits typed evidence and a verdict, and the promotion gate either CAS-promotes only the candidate weight root or quarantines it. Scientific evaluation instead forks a clean disposable clone and may write only reporting/audit products. Retry is classed before any further attempt: one operational crash before a valid verdict may retry the same content-addressed semantic inputs, seed, and configuration once; a second crash waits for the next evidence threshold; behavioral/preservation rejection never retries the same data; source/dose/visibility/provenance invalidity fails closed until separately authorized repair. Every failure preserves committed life roots and prior weights, quarantines candidate derivatives, and rebuilds DREAM. Fixed parenting emits identical reminders before lessons 1/9/17/25 regardless of behavior; only adaptive parenting may use frozen acquisition/fade/relapse rules. Treatment-induced life corpora and candidates may differ. The first affected CPU or GPU evaluation, writer, candidate, model, data, benchmark, or adapter packet remains closed until exact ES19 and ES20 receipts pass and stay hash-valid; later scopes retain their own gates.
claim_delta_interpretation: V4 supplies no scientific result. The retired R2/write-swarm writer observations receive no successor credit. A future experiential-memory claim needs separate source reproduction, retrieval-free held-out extraction, fresh native action use, exact support, directional semantic/provenance controls, preservation, and powered roots; lower source NLL or STATE_ONLY direct supervision is not recollection or use. Delta_R can support only immediate incremental T-versus-D selective use of identical novel advice at birth. Delta_F can support only acceleration of the fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP package under equal mechanisms and opportunities, not advice alone, intrinsic teachability, or identical realized writes. Delta_E can support only the selected adaptive parent+child+SLEEP package interaction. Repetition evidence is descriptive selective enactment unless reminder dose is independently randomized. The sentinel assay estimates dependence on its prospectively declared replay closure; its primary removal and dose-standardized filler sensitivity are distinct and neither is natural unreplayed retention. Rank-by-exposure is compiler-conditional capacity engineering only. Natural K4-K1 is the randomized total cadence package; terminal ledger comparisons are conditional descriptions, not mediation. Incremental target blindness excludes new downstream-derived construction input, not knowledge already in M0. Two-root screens license only the next separately authorized spend; claims require at least six newly frozen independent roots, exact analysis and multiplicity, all construct/safety/firewall gates, fresh review, and explicit human claim authority.
visibility_matrix_interpretation: The exact registry is a complete 15-information by 12-stage product with 180 unique cells. The twelve stages are BOOTSTRAP_BUILDER, BIRTH_WRITER, FIXED_PARENT_CONTROLLER, ADAPTIVE_PARENT_CONTROLLER, WAKE_CHILD, DREAM_CONTEXT_BUILDER, SLEEP_COMPILER, CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_EVALUATOR, LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE, DEPLOYMENT_EVALUATOR, ISOLATED_AUDITOR, and RELEASE_CONTROLLER. Per information type, the only non-forbidden cells are: final.hidden_answers is visible to DEPLOYMENT_EVALUATOR and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; development.public_observation is visible to ADAPTIVE_PARENT_CONTROLLER, WAKE_CHILD, DREAM_CONTEXT_BUILDER, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR and derived_only to SLEEP_COMPILER; evaluation.public_observation is visible only to DEPLOYMENT_EVALUATOR and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; bootstrap.parent_conditioning is visible only to BOOTSTRAP_BUILDER, BIRTH_WRITER, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; life.child_grounded_trace is visible to ADAPTIVE_PARENT_CONTROLLER, WAKE_CHILD, DREAM_CONTEXT_BUILDER, SLEEP_COMPILER, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; life.live_parent_text is visible to FIXED_PARENT_CONTROLLER, ADAPTIVE_PARENT_CONTROLLER, WAKE_CHILD, DREAM_CONTEXT_BUILDER, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; control.repetition_state is visible to both parent controllers and ISOLATED_AUDITOR and derived_only to LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE; audit.parent_state is visible to ADAPTIVE_PARENT_CONTROLLER and ISOLATED_AUDITOR and derived_only to FIXED_PARENT_CONTROLLER and LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE; cache.dream_context is visible only to WAKE_CHILD, DREAM_CONTEXT_BUILDER, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; evaluation.scientific_products is visible only to DEPLOYMENT_EVALUATOR and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; transaction.candidate_preservation_evidence is visible only to CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_EVALUATOR and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; transaction.promotion_verdict is visible only to CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_EVALUATOR, LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR; audit.release_decision is visible only to ISOLATED_AUDITOR and RELEASE_CONTROLLER; lineage.committed_head is visible to WAKE_CHILD, DREAM_CONTEXT_BUILDER, SLEEP_COMPILER, CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_EVALUATOR, LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE, DEPLOYMENT_EVALUATOR, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR and derived_only to RELEASE_CONTROLLER; transaction.candidate_closure is visible to SLEEP_COMPILER, CANDIDATE_PRESERVATION_EVALUATOR, and ISOLATED_AUDITOR and derived_only to LINEAGE_PROMOTION_GATE. Every unlisted cell is forbidden. derived_only means an opaque nonsemantic binding or declared projection and never overrides a forbidden cell for another type. Thus raw or derived parent/repetition semantics cannot reach SLEEP; DREAM serves waking only; scientific products cannot select candidates or releases; private preservation evidence cannot enter science or parents; and the gate can consume only opaque candidate/head bindings plus the typed verdict.
acceptance_test_interpretation: V2_ES01_EXACT_AUTHORITY binds every source, deliberation byte, requested scope, and later packet; this interpretation authorizes nothing. V4_ES02 requires dual-validator clause support and proves reminder schedule/count/order, adaptive state, and parent audit are semantically inert while independently grounded child enactments remain ordinarily eligible. V4_ES03 routes every arm and replay candidate through the sole writer, matches response counts/positions and exogenous optimizer opportunity, binds complete encoded/RNG/root state, permits identities only in declared treatment spans, and requires excluded-state taint invariance; no fallback, truncation, nonfinite skip, seed loss, or parent/repetition influence is allowed. V2_ES04 proves the zero-effective-delta initializer on CPU with one nonzero factor, flowing gradient, paired hashes, and an all-zero failure fixture before model work. V2_ES05 proves the FP32 reference merge, one BF16 rounding, deterministic immutable directory roots, equal tensor schemas/dtypes/ties/counts, no adapter residue, bounded symmetric rounding, and merged/unmerged parity before GPU work. V4_ES06 routes correct and mismatched births, separates reporting-only science from promotion-only preservation, and faults every snapshot/stage/verdict/fsync/CAS/quarantine/restart boundary; it enforces one identical-input operational retry, no same-data behavioral/preservation retry, invalid-source closure, lived-root survival, and failed-derivative nondiscovery. V2_ES07 joins and replays all 192-240 T/D pairs and audits the full prompt+target with two coders under the noncircular computation-3 and computation-6 rules; action/outcome/admission/slot and dose opportunity match, T is 100% declared computation, D is 0%, D is M0-noninferior within -0.05, and irreducible difficulty is reported. V2_ES08 freezes bootstrap before downstream instances, proves hermetic dependency and mutation noninterference through an isolated auditor, rejects renamed policy-isomorphic clones and action-prescribing advice, and supports only incremental blindness. V2_ES09 uses disposable same-state/seed correct/none/irrelevant/wrong clones with no SLEEP or feedback; mechanically selective action/outcome change and Delta_R >= +0.05 on both canary roots are a spend gate only. V4_ES10 fixes advice bytes, ages 1/9/17/25, tasks, budgets, writer/compiler/dose opportunities, gates, and disposable exams while intentionally allowing induced corpora/candidates to differ; Delta_F >= +0.03 on both roots supports only fixed-curriculum-plus-personal-SLEEP canary acceleration. V2_ES11 similarly requires the adaptive T/D by parent/solo package, equal nonparent resources, full parent information/effort receipts, terminal exams, Delta_E >= +0.03, and only the ecological package label. V4_ES12 proves fixed reminders ignore behavior, adaptive transitions fire only at frozen public criteria, control metadata never changes SLEEP, and only grounded selective enactment may enter life evidence. V2_ES13 separately freezes and scores source reproduction, held-out extraction, and fresh native use under correct, deranged, shuffled, wrong-life, repetition, adapter-off, and previous-child conditions with prospective directional predictions and preservation. V2_ES14 compares same-birth/same-later-evidence disposable cumulative and full descendant-closure-ablation candidates with identical RNG/config, plus a separately reported prefrozen disjoint filler sensitivity; no lineage feedback or unreplayed-retention claim is allowed. V2_ES15 crosses rank 8/16 with low/high equalized exposure after compiler selection and reports capacity-by-exposure only. V2_ES16 defers randomized K4/K1 and common-writer terminal rewrites until new authority and preserves total-package, standardized-ledger, and conditional writer/history labels only. V2_ES17 freezes binary engine success, zero handling, ages 0/8/16/24/32, normalized trapezoid AUC, +0.05 Delta_R, +0.03 Delta_F/Delta_E, -0.05 safety, root-level units, one unchanged-design mixed-sign rerun, and six-new-root confirmation before model execution. V4_ES19 enumerates and exercises all 180 visibility cells, taints forbidden inputs, and proves science changes reporting/audit only while preservation changes only staged verdict/promotion. V4_ES20 injects every failure class and boundary, proving exact retry classification, precommitted wake/parent/repetition survival, prior-weight continuity, derivative quarantine, DREAM rebuild, and exact next-head ancestry. V2_ES18 still requires post-implementation fresh independent review, a non-overriding advocate, and separate exact human GPU authority. V4_ES21 negatively dispatches every affected CPU/GPU evaluation, writer, candidate, model, benchmark-generation, adapter, and data packet and keeps it closed until hash-valid V4_ES19 and V4_ES20 receipts both pass; those receipts do not waive any later scope gate.
assumptions: The proposal's derived_only cells denote opaque transaction identities or explicitly declared nonsemantic projections; they do not permit dereferencing a separately forbidden information type.
development.public_observation reaches SLEEP only after ordinary support resolution inside an eligible life.child_grounded_trace; the raw environment stream is not an independent compiler corpus.

The retry's semantic build inputs, writer configuration, seed, and candidate snapshot are byte-identical; retry classification and detached operational attempt metadata may record that one retry occurred without becoming a writer input.

The fixed controller's visibility into life.live_parent_text denotes its frozen outgoing lesson bytes, while derived_only audit.parent_state is nonsemantic integrity metadata; it cannot observe child behavior or adapt timing.

The candidate-preservation evaluator can generate and inspect its private evidence and verdict only inside the staged transaction, and the promotion gate receives the verdict rather than raw preservation evidence.

The lineage head exposes to SLEEP only the opaque CAS token and separately authorized eligible life root; visibility of the head does not confer semantic access to parent, repetition, or DREAM contents referenced by the head.

All exact model, tokenizer, serializer, merge tolerance, support resolver, generator, rubric, statistic, CAS, audit-sidecar, replay-closure, and GPU bytes remain later separately scoped contracts as the proposal states.
The four bootstrap microdomains remain candidates until structural and difficulty audits pass, and at least six new roots are a minimum claim condition rather than automatic sufficiency.

ambiguities.question: What exact schemas and noninterference checks define each derived_only projection for development observations, repetition state, parent state, committed head, candidate closure, and release binding?
ambiguities.impact: A projection that contains semantic bytes, content-derived selectors, or dereferenceable handles could bypass the otherwise complete type firewall; these bytes must be frozen before implementation.

ambiguities.question: Which retry/attempt fields are detached operational metadata, and how is byte-identical retry input identity proved while still recording the first crash and sole retry?
ambiguities.impact: Putting a changing attempt counter into encoded writer inputs, RNG namespaces, cache keys, or candidate identity would violate exact-input retry, while omitting it from audit state would make retry limits unauditable.

ambiguities.question: What canonical committed-head and candidate-closure descriptors, root encodings, lock/CAS primitives, fsync ordering, quarantine namespaces, and recovery rules instantiate the selected lineage graph?
ambiguities.impact: The architecture fixes ancestry and visibility, but byte-distinct transaction implementations could otherwise admit stale promotion, torn state, or directory discovery.

ambiguities.question: What exact clause-support resolver, DREAM cache-key/rebuild protocol, and isolated parent-exclusion sidecar prove that only child-grounded evidence enters SLEEP without returning parent-derived values?
ambiguities.impact: These downstream mechanics decide whether unsupported thought, stale context, or a tainted exclusion receipt becomes a covert compiler input.

ambiguities.question: What exhaustive dispatcher registry maps every affected CPU evaluation, writer, candidate, model, data, benchmark, adapter, and GPU action to the hash-valid ES19/ES20 prerequisites?
ambiguities.impact: A new or legacy route omitted from the dispatcher registry could execute before the two model-free safety invariants even though V4_ES21 requires universal fail-closed ordering.

ambiguities.question: Which exact writer factorial, support and replay-closure rules, generator/split roots, computation rubrics, structural thresholds, safety comparators, allocation, intervals, and multiplicity procedures instantiate later evidence packets?
ambiguities.impact: The architecture and test meanings are determinate, but these values are required for reproducible execution and claims and must not be chosen after outcomes.
